Reviewer reopen: dispatch-to-running PASS is confirmed, but two runtime claims in the evidence are wrong and must be corrected before approval. VERIFIED TRUE: supervisor log supervisor-watchdog-restart-20260728T132125Z.log:19 (21:25:22 local) lists claude1_1:OPS-L12-CLAUDE-DISPATCH-SMOKE-20260728(running); claude_cli path confirmed via config.json agents.claude.adapter=claude_cli, providers.claude.delivery_mode=claude_cli and run status command[0]=.orchestrator/bin/claude, started_at 13:24:41Z; log shows CLI 2.1.220, claude-opus-5[1m], session 6964721c-0447-4925-9d88-39036582a893, rate_limit_event allowed_warning seven_day 0.53, all read-only tool calls is_error=false, permission_denials empty, runtime SHA 061408b09 echoed; worktree HEAD 061408b09 with zero tracked diff and only the untracked supervisor-materialized brief. CORRECTION 1: 'Claude recorded governed task start at 13:25:34Z' is false. Event seq 3374/3375 carries 'Supervisor auto-started ... after successful dispatch', emitted only by supervisor.py:7215 REASON_OWNED_READY dispatch-sync, which shells ai_status.py start with AI_NAME=Claude plus the worker lease (hence the run-id source). The Claude process had already exited at 13:25:24Z with exit_code 143 / signal 15, and its transcript contains no ai-status start call; last event is '[Request interrupted by user]' at 13:25:22.696Z with terminal_reason aborted_streaming. CORRECTION 2: 'boot reconciliation marked process missing at 13:26:33Z' is false. Event seq 3380 source is supervisor-preempt with message 'Supervisor preempted ... to free Claude for higher-priority review/finalize work', and the supervisor log at 21:26:39 records 'worker superseded for priority escalation: task=OPS-L12-CLAUDE-DISPATCH-SMOKE-20260728 provider=claude1-1 run=claude1-1-20260728T132440Z-0ed52b7d'. Actual termination was SIGTERM 69s earlier at 13:25:24Z, not a missing-process reconciliation. REQUIRED FIX: rewrite the evidence so the start transition is attributed to the supervisor dispatch-sync auto-start and the run end is described as SIGTERM at 13:25:24Z followed by supervisor preempt/supersede at 13:26:33Z. Keep the verified PASS facts as-is; make no repository or config changes.

Please independently review the corrected evidence.
